resources.string:
This app is a personal diary for your blood pressure readings.

It is not a medical device. It does not give medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition. Classifications and statistics are for information only and can be wrong.

Always talk to your doctor about your readings and your treatment. Never change your medication or its dose based on information from this app.

In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Your readings are stored on your device. If Android backup is turned on, they are included in your encrypted device backup.

You use this app at your own risk. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and comes without any warranty.
